For those of us who already know we are unable to participate in the "regular" NaNoWriMo, NaNoPoMo is basically this;

  • Write one [blog] entry per day for 30 days.
  • At a minimum word count.

Sounds doable! If all else fails do what I'm going to do; pick 30 of your story ideas and for each day of November write at least 2,500 words for each one.
Got a blog? Wanna write don't have anything? Try NaNoPoMo!

Freaking spectacular idea! I think I'm going to try this, but don't quote me on that because I'm probably speaking in the moment. It's been years since I've participated in National Novel Writing Month, so maybe this is close enough.
By all means, participate however you can! If you need a place to start, /v/writingprompts is hosting it's own variation and I welcome you to join.
